definitions.full: H7507. rephidah [ רְפִידָה ] noun feminine perhaps support (compare Arabic above), i.e. back, or arm, of palanquin; suffix רְפִידָתוֺ Song 3:10 ; ᵐ5 ἀνάκλιτον , ᵑ9 reclinatorium.
